parameters.content:
## WP Indexer Smart — setup
Checks every published post with the **Search Console URL Inspection API** and sends **only the URLs that are not indexed** to the Google Indexing API (+ IndexNow). Mails a report.

**Credentials**
- **Basic Auth** (WordPress user + Application Password) → Fetch All Posts
- **Google Service Account API**, "Set up for use in HTTP Request node" ON, scopes:
`https://www.googleapis.com/auth/indexing, https://www.googleapis.com/auth/webmasters.readonly`
→ Inspect URL + Google Indexing API. Add the service account e-mail as an **Owner** of the Search Console property.
- **SMTP** → Send Report Mail

**Config**: site URL, `search_console_property` (`sc-domain:example.com` or `https://example.com/`), optional IndexNow key.

Manual trigger — swap in a Schedule Trigger if you want it periodic (mind the quotas).
